lt.line: Besileidžiant nuo kalno, Jėzus jiems įsakė: „Niekam nepasakokite apie regėjimą, kol Žmogaus Sūnus prisikels iš numirusių.

en.event: Feast of the Transfiguration of the Lord
en.line: As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus charged them, “Do not tell the vision to anyone until the Son of Man has been raised from the dead.
